breakdown.description: The inward normal load on the horizontal top edge is reinterpreted as horizontal compression along the edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the inward normal traction as a vertical downward force t = (0, -5000) on the horizontal top edge, explicitly calling it a 'true inward normal traction' and noting it corresponds to the local boundary-normal direction. This directly contradicts the flawed prompt's instruction to apply it as horizontal compression along the edge, and aligns with the ground truth's instruction to interpret the load in the local boundary-normal direction.
